description: A logged-in user can set their profile image from an arbitrary URL. The server fetches that URL itself (SSRF), not the browser; confirmed with an out-of-band callback listener that recorded the backend's own User-Agent ("node") making the request. Any destination reachable from the container, not just image hosts, is fetchable this way.
expected_exploit_indicator: The attacker-controlled callback listener on the attacker_callback_host receives a request with the test's random marker in the path
expected_blocked_signal: No callback received within the wait window, with the endpoint rejecting or no-oping the request instead of fetching it
legitimate_check: A profile-image URL pointing at the trusted_image_cdn_host (standing in for a vetted, allowlisted image CDN) must still be fetchable in every condition.
